services.value: Florida-Spectrum provides environmental testing and analytical chemistry services using EPA approved procedures, including analysis of groundwater, surface water, drinking water, soil, and hazardous wastes. Capabilities include Atomic Absorption, ICP, Ion Chromatography, Gas Chromatography, Mass Spectrometry, Microbiology, Radiochemistry, Wet Chemistry, and it also provides sampling-related services such as sample bottle kits, on-site sampling services, and sample courier services.
